statement: ∀ (X : Type*) [MetricSpace X] (A : Set X) (a δ : ℝ) (U : ℕ → Set X), Cover δ A U → BasisObjects.content a (ENNReal.ofReal δ) A ≤ cost a U
proof:
intro X _ A a δ U hU
unfold BasisObjects.content cost
exact iInf_le_of_le U (iInf_le_of_le hU.1 (iInf_le_of_le hU.2 le_rfl))
